page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: Lavicam, in quam delecti fingularum claffium coëunt, nunc in urbe, sæpius in agro, locis celebrioribus. Cæteroqui, ad conventus menstruos & ordinarios quod attinet, nihil habent urbani cum ministris agrariis commune.
main_text.head: DE ERGASTERIO GRONINGANO.
main_text.p: LIbet hoc loco nunc inserere institutum tum temporis nondum hîc natum, cùm libellum hunc in lucem primùm emitterem, sumptum à sociis vicinis, Reip. haud inuti-Ergasterium ea-fligandæ nequitiæ.le. Id ἐργαςτήριον[?] est castigandæ exultantinequitiæ & ignaviæ, quale in urbe Leowerdia descripsi. Locus ei est in parte cœnobii Dominicani sumptu provinciæ totius adornatus, variè in cellulas & officinas distinctus, institutoque tali accommodatus, nebulonum & inertium hominum carcer. Nam qui coërceri domi à suis, & in obsequio ac officio retineri non possunt, item errones, moribus profligati,

page.notes: The drop cap "L" is joined to "Ibet" as printed ("LIbet"); the first letter is a woodcut-style initial and is marked as the likely letter. The Greek word ἐργαςτήριον is uncertain in its final letters and is marked [?]. The printed "inserere" and the cùm/hîc accents were read from a small scan and may be inexact. The marginal note is printed as "Ergaste-/rium ea-/fligandæ/nequitiæ." and is given as one note. Reading "castigandæ exultantinequitiæ" in the text: the printed line break after "exultan-" continues "ti nequitiæ" in the next line, so the word is "exultanti" and the note is not part of the text.
